purpose: Cases that the current JSON-schema/static-fixture layer can admit even though protocol semantics require rejection or additional cryptographic verification.

cases.mutation: recipient_storage receipt keeps recipient_principal=host:vera but changes signer.principal to host:other
cases.current_gap: receipt.schema.json constrains signer shape/role but cannot assert signer.principal equals recipient_principal

cases.mutation: receipt signer.key_id and signature.key_id are two different syntactically valid 64-hex values
cases.current_gap: schema does not bind signature.key_id to signer.key_id

cases.mutation: relay_custody receipt uses relay_installation_id=A while signer.principal names relay:B
cases.current_gap: schema checks relay: prefix but does not bind signer identity to installation identity/trusted custody key
cases.required_conformance: reject unless signer key is pinned to the exact trusted relay installation and epoch

cases.mutation: outer recipient_principal is host:vera while aad_binding.recipient_principal is host:other; all individual fields remain schema-valid
cases.current_gap: schema describes equality semantically but JSON Schema does not enforce cross-object equality; current happy-path test does not include hostile mismatch fixture

cases.mutation: pairing proof is 64 zero bytes encoded as base64
cases.current_gap: schema validates encoding/length only; current fixture labeled valid uses exactly this non-ECDSA value and tests do not verify the nested proof
cases.required_conformance: nested proof must either be removed as redundant or verified against a normatively defined signature base

cases.mutation: two clients sign different byte serializations while both set proof.context=veramesh-v1/pairing-redeem
cases.current_gap: no normative bytes-to-sign are defined for the nested proof
cases.required_conformance: all conforming clients sign the same exact bytes or the nested proof is not part of V1

cases.mutation: encode the same aad_binding JSON with different key order/insignificant whitespace
cases.current_gap: Python tests hash a locally defined sorted/minified JSON representation but normative protocol text does not bind that representation
cases.required_conformance: freeze exact AAD serialization bytes and hash those exact bytes across Node/Java/Python

cases.mutation: sign different serializations/subsets of the same receipt claims
cases.current_gap: receipt schema specifies algorithm/encoding but not the exact signed claim bytes
cases.required_conformance: freeze one exact receipt signature base and reject every other representation
